name: io.github.zalaso/sharebox
title: ShareBox
description: Publish the web tools your agent builds to a self-hosted ShareBox and share them like a Google Doc

environmentVariables.name: SHAREBOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your ShareBox instance, e.g. https://sharebox.example.com (not needed after `sharebox login`)

environmentVariables.name: SHAREBOX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for that instance (not needed after `sharebox login`)
